strategic_architecture: 'RogSi' - Grixis (U/B/R) partner combo, one of the fastest decks in the format, aiming to win turns 1-3 via free interaction (enabled by controlling a 0-cost creature commander) and a dense package of spell-based kills; Silas Renn adds artifact recursion for grindier games. Ad Nauseam is a named cornerstone. Sources: EDHREC 'Building RogSi for cEDH', Commander's Herald 'An Introduction to RogSi in cEDH'.
